Sales

Module · Lead role: Sales Functional Consultant · Subject lead: Robert Peledie

Dynamics 365 Sales delivery: lead to opportunity, sales process stages, products and price lists, quotes and orders, forecasting, sequences, Copilot in Sales and the Outlook and Teams experience.

  • sales:copilot-in-salesdraft

    Plans Copilot enablement for sellers in Dynamics 365 Sales and in Outlook and Teams, covering use cases, data readiness, security, admin settings, piloting and measuring value. Use when a customer wants Copilot for the sales team, asks why summaries or drafts are poor, or needs a readiness check before AI features are switched on.

    Stages: Strategize, Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: Sales

  • sales:forecastingdraft

    Configures sales forecasting in Dynamics 365 Sales, including the forecast hierarchy, periods, columns, quotas, forecast categories, adjustments and permissions. Use when setting up forecasts for the first time, choosing between a manager or territory hierarchy, loading quotas, or working out why the forecast does not match the pipeline report.

    Stages: Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: Sales

  • sales:lead-to-opportunitydraft

    Designs how leads are captured, qualified, disqualified and converted into accounts, contacts and opportunities in Dynamics 365 Sales. Use when deciding whether to use leads at all, defining qualification evidence, setting what qualify creates and how duplicates are caught, or tidying lead ownership and disqualify reasons.

  • sales:outlook-and-teams-integrationdraft

    Designs server-side synchronisation, the Dynamics 365 App for Outlook and Teams collaboration for CRM users, covering mailbox setup, tracking rules, contact and appointment sync and record collaboration in Teams. Use when connecting mailboxes, deciding what gets tracked, or fixing sync errors and duplicate contacts.

  • sales:products-and-price-listsdraft

    Designs the product catalogue in Dynamics 365 Sales, including product families, bundles, unit groups, price lists, discount lists and currencies, and decides whether CRM or ERP owns products and pricing. Use when structuring products, setting up price lists per market, or planning catalogue synchronisation with an ERP.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Prepare · Modules: Sales, Field Service

  • sales:quotes-and-ordersdraft

    Designs the quote to order to invoice flow in Dynamics 365 Sales, covering quote revisions, discount approvals, document output, order capture and the point where an ERP takes over pricing, fulfilment or invoicing. Use when building quoting, deciding what CRM and ERP each own, or designing quote approval and generation.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Prepare · Modules: Sales

  • sales:sales-process-stagesdraft

    Designs the opportunity sales process in Dynamics 365 Sales, covering business process flows, stage gates, required evidence, probability and close outcomes. Use when turning a sales methodology into stages, deciding gate rules, choosing between branches and separate flows, or fixing a pipeline that sellers and managers do not trust.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Operate · Modules: Sales

  • sales:sequences-and-sales-acceleratordraft

    Designs seller cadences with sales accelerator sequences, the work list, segments and assignment rules in Dynamics 365 Sales. Use when building outreach sequences for new leads or renewals, configuring the work list, automating lead and opportunity assignment, or deciding what belongs in a sequence rather than a marketing journey.

    Stages: Implement, Operate · Modules: Sales

Business Analysis

Turning business need into CRM requirements: process mapping, user stories, fit-to-standard workshops, fit-gap analysis and acceptance criteria.

  • business-analysis:acceptance-criteriadraft

Use when designing the training approach, preparing train-the-trainer, setting up a training environment, or planning training for new joiners and release waves.

    Stages: Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

  • change-adoption:stakeholder-analysisdraft

    Identifies stakeholder groups for a Dynamics 365 CE rollout and assesses change impact by role across process, system, data, reporting and ways of working, to size the change effort and target engagement. Use when starting change planning, assessing how ready a business unit is, or building a change impact assessment for a phase or module.

    Stages: Strategize, Initiate, Implement · Modules: All

  • change-adoption:super-user-networkdraft

    Designs and runs a super-user network for Dynamics 365 CE, covering the role, selection from declared skills and availability, agreed time commitment, enablement, and their part in testing, training, hypercare and release waves. Use when recruiting super users, defining their responsibilities, or keeping the network active after go-live.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

Platform Administration

Delivery · Lead role: Dynamics 365 and Power Platform Administrator · Subject lead: Simon Foote

Running the platform: environment setup, licensing and capacity, monitoring, release readiness for release waves, and agent governance.

  • platform-administration:agent-governancedraft

    Governs who can build, share and publish Copilot Studio agents, flows and apps across the tenant, using DLP policies, environment zoning, Managed Environments controls, the CoE Starter Kit and an agent approval path. Use when setting maker policies, approving an agent for wider release, or tracking down ungoverned agents.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Operate · Modules: All

  • platform-administration:environment-setupdraft

    Provisions and configures Dynamics 365 CE environments to the agreed strategy, covering type, region, base currency and language, security groups, admin roles, application users and baseline settings. Use when creating or configuring an environment, restricting who can open it, or setting up service identities for integrations and pipelines.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Prepare · Modules: All

  • platform-administration:licensing-and-capacitydraft

    Structures Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing and Dataverse capacity questions by persona, usage, environment and growth, and sets up ongoing licence and storage review. Use when estimating licences for a programme, checking whether capacity covers planned environments and data, or reviewing usage after go-live.

    Stages: Strategize, Initiate, Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

  • platform-administration:monitoringdraft

    Sets up operational monitoring for Dynamics 365 CE and Power Platform, covering service health, Message center, capacity, plug-in and flow failures, integration errors, telemetry, business heartbeats and alert routing. Use when preparing operations before go-live, deciding what to alert on and who receives it, or when users find failures first.

    Stages: Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

  • platform-administration:release-readinessdraft

    Prepares a Dynamics 365 CE estate for Microsoft updates, covering roadmap tracking on the AI at Work roadmap, release waves and early access, impact assessment, regression testing, feature enablement and user communication. Use when a major update approaches, early access opens, or a roadmap item or deprecation affects the solution.

    Stages: Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

Support Operations

Delivery · Lead role: Service Owner and Support Lead · Subject lead: Robert Peledie

Going live and staying live: cutover planning, hypercare, the support model, incident management and continuous improvement.

  • support-operations:continuous-improvementdraft

    Runs the post-go-live improvement cycle for Dynamics 365 CE with one prioritised backlog, a release cadence aligned to Microsoft release waves, adoption feedback loops and value reporting to the sponsor. Use when setting up the backlog after hypercare, agreeing a release rhythm, or deciding what to improve next.

    Stages: Operate · Modules: All

  • support-operations:cutover-plandraft

    Plans the move from legacy systems to live Dynamics 365 CE as a timed, owned runbook with rehearsals, data freeze rules, decision checkpoints and rollback triggers. Use when building or rehearsing a cutover runbook, agreeing a data freeze, sequencing final migration and integration switch-on, or deciding the point of no return.

    Stages: Implement, Prepare · Modules: All

  • support-operations:hypercaredraft

    Runs the hypercare period after a Dynamics 365 CE go-live, setting scope, planned duration, staffing, daily triage, fix cadence and exit criteria for handing over to business-as-usual support. Use when planning hypercare, running triage in the first weeks after go-live, or deciding whether to extend or exit hypercare.

    Stages: Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

  • support-operations:incident-managementdraft

    Defines how Dynamics 365 CE incidents are classified, escalated, communicated and closed, including severity definitions, major incident handling, escalation to Microsoft and post-incident review. Use when writing severity definitions, handling a live outage or serious defect, or setting up post-incident and problem reviews.

    Stages: Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

  • support-operations:support-modeldraft

    Designs the business-as-usual support model for Dynamics 365 CE, covering support tiers, partner versus internal responsibilities, Microsoft support cases, the service owner role and support access to production. Use when deciding who supports the system after go-live, scoping a partner support contract, or defining routes to Microsoft.

    Stages: Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

Design Authority Reviewer-class

Reviewer · Lead role: Lead Architect · Subject lead: Both

Reviewer-class: design review, customisation challenge, standards conformance and change impact assessment. Blocking findings are not overruled by the department under review.

  • design-authority:change-impact-assessmentdraft

    Assesses proposed changes to a signed-off Dynamics 365 CE design for impact on data model, automation, security, integrations, migration, testing, training, cost and timeline, recording findings as blocking or advisory. Use when a change request arrives after design sign-off, during UAT or cutover, or after go-live.

    Stages: Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

  • design-authority:customisation-challengedraft

    Challenges proposed customisations of Dynamics 365 CE by walking them down the gap resolution hierarchy (adopt standard, configure, low-code, pro-code, ISV) and testing supportability over time. Use when a team proposes custom code, a new custom table, a PCF control, an ISV product or any departure from standard behaviour.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement · Modules: All

  • design-authority:design-reviewdraft

    Reviews Dynamics 365 CE solution designs against the approved blueprint, architecture principles and project standards, and records each finding as blocking or advisory. Use when a workstream submits a design for approval at a gate or before build, or when a design appears to depart from the blueprint or clash with another workstream.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement · Modules: All

  • design-authority:standards-conformancedraft

    Checks built Dynamics 365 CE components against project standards for naming, publisher prefix, solution layering, security and ALM, and reports each nonconformity as blocking or advisory. Use when reviewing solutions before deployment, auditing an environment for drift, onboarding a new partner, or gathering release evidence.

    Stages: Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

Security and Compliance Reviewer-class

Reviewer · Lead role: Security Architect and Data Protection Officer · Subject lead: Both

Reviewer-class: security model review, business units and teams, field-level security, marketing consent compliance and data retention. Blocking findings are not overruled by the department under review.

  • security-compliance:business-units-and-teamsdraft

    Designs and reviews the Dataverse business unit tree and the use of owner, access and Entra ID group teams, so that data is segregated only where it must be, and classifies findings as blocking or advisory. Use when deciding business units, choosing team types, planning a restructure or modelling several legal entities.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Operate · Modules: All

  • security-compliance:data-retentiondraft

    Designs and reviews how long CRM data is kept and how it is deleted, anonymised or retained, covering bulk deletion, Dataverse long-term retention, audit logs, call recordings and downstream copies, and classifies findings as blocking or advisory. Use when setting retention rules, planning deletion jobs or handling erasure requests.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

  • security-compliance:field-level-securitydraft

    Decides which Dataverse columns need column-level protection, designs field security profiles and checks that the protection holds in exports, reports and integrations, classifying findings as blocking or advisory. Use when values such as salary, bank details or vulnerability flags must be hidden from some users who can see the record.

    Stages: Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

  • security-compliance:marketing-consent-compliancedraft

    Reviews marketing consent against UK GDPR and PECR, covering lawful basis, consent records, soft opt-in, preference centres, tracking and subject access across Customer Insights - Journeys and seller outreach, and classifies findings as blocking or advisory. Use when marketing is about to go live or consent is being migrated.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: Marketing, Sales

  • security-compliance:security-model-reviewdraft

    Reviews a Dataverse security model as an independent reviewer, covering security roles, privilege depth, teams, hierarchy security, record sharing and Entra ID access, and classifies every finding as blocking or advisory. Use when a role matrix needs sign-off, before UAT or go-live, or when users see records they should not.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Prepare, Operate · Modules: All

Project Tailoring

Tailoring · Lead role: Project Tailoring Lead · Subject lead: Simon Foote

Turns an organisation profile of team, goals and estate into a tailored pack: edition choice, project roles filled from declared skills, skills gaps, and ready-to-complete Word and Excel templates.

  • project-tailoring:document-packdraft

    Fills the twelve project templates from the organisation profile, the edition decision and the confirmed role mapping, and writes Word and Excel drafts to the output folder in the user workspace, never into the repository. Use when a team wants its tailored charter, RACI, plans, logs and checklists produced as a first draft pack.

    Stages: Strategize, Initiate · Modules: All

  • project-tailoring:edition-selectiondraft

    Recommends the SMB or Enterprise edition of the roster for a project from its modules, user numbers, integrations, legal entities and team size, giving the reason for each signal and explaining borderline cases. Use when tailoring starts, when someone asks whether their project is SMB or Enterprise, or when scope changes.

    Stages: Strategize, Initiate · Modules: All

  • project-tailoring:pack-refreshdraft

    Re-runs the tailored pack after the organisation profile changes, re-checking edition, roles and gaps only where the change reaches, keeping earlier versions and reporting what moved. Use when scope, team, dates or estate change, when people join or leave the project, or before a stage gate that needs an up-to-date pack.

    Stages: Initiate, Implement, Prepare · Modules: All

  • project-tailoring:profile-intakedraft

    Builds or validates the organisation profile that drives a tailored roster pack, checking a YAML file against the schema or interviewing the user, and asks only for what is missing while defaulting to aliases for people. Use when tailoring starts, when a profile fails validation or when someone wants to describe their organisation.

    Stages: Strategize, Initiate · Modules: All

  • project-tailoring:role-mappingdraft

    Proposes who holds each delivery role by matching declared skills and availability against the role catalogue, gives a one-line reason per role, flags uncovered, over-allocated and unsafe role combinations, and never ranks people. Use when a profile lists the team and the project lead needs a first role assignment to confirm.

    Stages: Strategize, Initiate · Modules: All

  • project-tailoring:skills-gap-analysisdraft

    Lists the delivery roles the team cannot cover from declared skills and availability and recommends training, a contractor or a partner for each, with the reason and the stage by which it is needed. Use when role mapping shows gaps, when planning outside help or when deciding who will own the platform after go-live.

    Stages: Strategize, Initiate · Modules: All
